surprises: PROOF-SCHEMA TAXONOMY GAP -- RAISED AND CLOSED WITHIN THE HOUR, recorded because the repair is more instructive than the gap. PROOF_OF_SPEC.schema.json's `phase` enum declared its layer as 'build-program phase, or the two non-build values' while its build members were only the DS PIPELINE program's phases (P1-SCRIPTS..P5-DECOMMISSION). A COMPONENT BUILD matched none, so the only selectable value was NON-BUILD-OTHER, FALSE of a build -- postulate (i), CE half, failing against its own declared layer. I set the false value and DECLARED the mislabel rather than let a reader infer a non-build TO. Routed to 4.0.0_SA_CRO, who routed it to 2.0.0_SA_COO as the standard's owner; closed @1ebf89980d with BUILD-GENERAL, which this instance now carries. ⛔ THE PART WORTH KEEPING: CRO recommended BUILD-OTHER and the MANDATED TOKEN CENSUS DISQUALIFIED IT -- `grep -w BUILD-OTHER` matches INSIDE its own sibling NON-BUILD-OTHER (raw 59 = 58 sibling hits + 1 genuine), so landing it would have put two values on one axis in a PERMANENT SUBSTRING RELATIONSHIP: every future census, audit or grep keyed on one silently includes the other, forever, with no error -- a contaminated denominator built into the vocabulary itself. Not a defect in the reasoning, a defect in a NAME, caught only because the rule forces the measurement BEFORE the landing.

The deploy-completion ledger -- the estate's closest embryo to the Cumulative_Residue_Ledger -- is written ENTIRELY by agent CLI self-assertion (cmd_open / cmd_close_leg / cmd_close / cmd_hold), which is precisely the admissibility model PRD sec.2.7 declares INADMISSIBLE. K3 therefore CANNOT be built by extending it. Not a defect in the deploy ledger (it is correct for a coordination record); a defect only if inherited. Routed to 2.0.0_SA_COO.

TF plan-vs-state-serial is named in the TO as one of OUR partial tokens. Measured, it is not ours at all: 1 hit in .tools/ against a control of 13 for HALT_ACK. The mechanism is internal to the terraform binary -- we consume it, cannot extend it, cannot make it emit an Observation_Record, and it covers only TF-managed mutations, which is exactly why the PRD names raw S3 put as the naked spot. Routed to 2.0.0_SA_COO.

HALTGT supplies the right checkpoint PLACEMENT and none of the evidence model -- CLAUDE.md Rule 18 already records that a HALTGT pass is not evidence. A C6 checkpoint concluding 'no objection was raised, therefore proceed' would reproduce that defect one layer up. Carried into the design: no checkpoint concludes from absence-of-signal.
